subject.title: fix(ai): preserve thinking blocks on historical turns with tool calls

question: Should this PR be repaired toward the canonical current-turn Anthropic replay policy, or paused/closed in favor of https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383?
rationale: The branch chooses a provider replay policy that conflicts with current-main active-tool-turn behavior and overlaps an open proof-positive replay PR, so automation should not choose the final landing path.

options.title: Repair Toward Canonical Replay Scope
options.body: Require removal of root policy edits, apply the same current-turn or active-tool replay policy in both Anthropic builders, and ask for redacted live Anthropic proof.

options.title: Pause For Canonical PR
options.body: If maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 as the intended fix, stop this branch to avoid competing replay semantics.

options.title: Accept Broad Preservation
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept replaying completed tool-call thinking, but that owns the invalid-signature compatibility and message-delivery risk.

recommendation.title: Repair Toward Canonical Replay Scope
recommendation.body: Require removal of root policy edits, apply the same current-turn or active-tool replay policy in both Anthropic builders, and ask for redacted live Anthropic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the Anthropic adaptive-thinking and AI package-boundary work involved in the policy tradeoff.
